AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'sweep-adopt-veridian-scripts-405-fix-directive-engine-run-check-duplicate' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  directive_engine.py                                |  51 ++++-
 ...rective_engine_fail_closed_duplicate_battery.py | 244 +++++++++++++++++++++
 tests/test_directive_engine_retry_gate.py          |  20 ++
 3 files changed, 307 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: The code itself is sound (run_check_duplicate_battery() now returns (result, call_failed) and process_one() correctly checks call_failed before ever calling submit_task(), with good test coverage for the happy path, the call-failure path, and the pre-existing duplicate_found path), but this diff is not new work: the current repo HEAD is literally commit 60c8eed, 'fix(directive_engine): run_check_duplicate_battery fails CLOSED, not open', which already contains this exact change (same 51/8 line diff stat, same UMR references, same test files), and `git diff HEAD -- directive_engine.py tests/` against the workspace shows zero differences -- the fix has already been merged to main. Merging this again would be a redundant no-op at best and risks a duplicate/confusing merge commit at worst, directly violating the NO DUPLICATION standing rule (verify real incremental code exists / check task state before assigning or merging scope). Issues found: This diff is byte-identical to already-merged commit 60c8eed on main (workspace HEAD == 60c8eed); there is no incremental change to merge.; Task should be closed as duplicate of already-completed work rather than merged; if the dispatch queue re-surfaced this scope, the underlying no-duplication check (task state vs CONTROLLER.yaml / existing merged commits) needs to be fixed so this doesn't recur.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
